about_the_game:
About the Game

Low and Furious (LAF), known only in Brazil as Baixos de Quebrada (BDQ), is a vehicle-driving game where you can customize the car of your dreams! Slam it to the ground, add window tints, change the wheels, install a booming sound system, and much more!

Beyond customization, you can participate in street races to gain reputation and complete missions that help you earn money. With it, you'll be able to upgrade your car or purchase new vehicles and garages.

Inspired by Brazilian environments, the game features a rich setting that includes favelas and other iconic locations on a fictional island called Juiz de Santos, delivering an immersive and engaging experience.

LAF / BDQ is a tribute to classic racing games, featuring modernized graphics and updated gameplay. It's made to captivate both racing enthusiasts and car customization fans.

What's Available in the Demo?

In the demo, you’ll be able to:

  • Explore part of the map.

  • Find a few limited collectibles.

  • Participate in 15 races, divided into:

    • 3 Drift (score-based)

    • 4 Circuit

    • 4 Sprint

    • 4 Time Attack

  • Play with 3 available cars (2 of them must be purchased in the in-game shop).

  • Buy a property.

  • Visit 4 available shops (one is secret and not listed below):

    • Mechanic Shop, Paint Shop, Sound Shop

    • Plus, the Dealership and Betran (where you register your car).

Limitations in the Demo

  • Not all customization parts are available.

  • Only 4 weather types (including day and night).

  • Some phone functions are disabled.

  • The initial game progression is missing.

  • Not all songs are available.

  • Some full-game activities are not included.

  • Some scenery elements have been removed.

  • And more...

Demo Highlights

You’ll be able to freely change the weather — try out different weather conditions and times of day to see how they transform the vibe!
⚠️ This feature will only be available in the demo.

There’s a loophole in the demo that might let you go beyond its boundaries.
Can you find it? And what will you discover if you do? 👀

Important Notice

The demo content does not represent the final version of the game. Elements may be added, removed, or changed before the full release.
Also, demo progress will not carry over to the full version.

What’s the Goal of the Demo?

The demo was created so players can test the game, report bugs, and give us feedback on their experience.
We want to hear from the community and improve the game based on your input!

This is an independent project developed by a small team of just 2 people (recently +1), focused on delivering a unique and fun experience.
We hope you enjoy exploring Low and Furious / Baixos de Quebrada and help us make it even better!

Message to Content Creators 🎥🎶

You’re free to play all the in-game music during your gameplay — all tracks are original and AI-generated. 🚗💨🎵

⚠️ Warning: The only exception is the track by artist Flávio Duin.
Do not let this track play during your content, as it may cause copyright issues.

Feel free to record and share your gameplay of Low and Furious / Baixos de Quebrada! 🏁🔥
